projections.equirect: lon -180..180 left to right, lat +90 at top, pixel-registered
projections.polar_stereo: spherical polar stereographic, true scale at the pole, R = 1737400 m; r = 2R tan((90-|lat|)/2); south: x = r sin(lon), y = r cos(lon); north: x = r sin(lon), y = -r cos(lon); image top = +y, left = -x
